source.title: Software Team Leader Announcement (June 2025)
source.content:
We are pleased to announce that Gregor Billing has been re-appointed as WCA Software Team (WST) Leader. Gregor’s new term will be effective **until 24th June 2027**.

Gregor was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote, as described in Section 5 of our [motion about WCA Committees and Teams](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf). 

The Board sincerely thanks Gregor for his willingness to remain on as the Team Leader for WCA Software Team and wishes him all the best in this new term.

Gregor was one of the two applications we received. You can view all the candidacy documents [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1V_ZxFABJBNydKjIbXkMcCjzHpkguhjTe).

translation.title: WCA 软件组负责人任命公告（2025 年 6 月）
translation.content:
我们很高兴地宣布，Gregor Billing 再次获任 WCA 软件组（WST）负责人。Gregor 的新任期将**持续至 2027 年 6 月 24 日**。

根据[《WCA 委员会与团队动议》](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 5 节，WCA 董事会选定了 Gregor，并通过投票批准其任命。

董事会衷心感谢 Gregor 愿意继续担任 WST 负责人，祝他在新任期内工作顺利。

我们共收到两份申请，Gregor 是其中一位申请者。全部申请材料可在[这里](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1V_ZxFABJBNydKjIbXkMcCjzHpkguhjTe)查看。
